ratings_why.fun: Dense web of chains: Berus kills Chorus Snakes so they get back up with +4 Attack and Claque's cheer, Mr Grey eats a Tail to grow Anguis, Coronella sells into the Prompter's slot; I'd happily draft it.
ratings_why.distinct: The core is Battlegrounds' Deathrattle, Reborn and Titus pattern; Understudy, sell-as-death and Notices fed by other tribes' fodder are the fresh parts.

verdict_why: The v2 clarity fixes landed and nothing is broken; further passes would mostly reshuffle numbers.

points.text: The Natterjack's 4 Notices is met almost every fight once an Encore unit is down, so it has no decision; a higher bar or a scaling payout would make it a choice.

Encore and Understudy pull against each other, since an Encore lead refills its own slot and the understudy never steps in. That's a good casting tension; a card that pays when an Encore lead stays down would reward choosing it.

Firing the Wreath-Bearer in the shop with the Rehearser or Coronella to hand out Encore for next fight is a lovely off-label use; one more recruit-phase Death Scene of this kind would deepen the shop game.
The Bill-Poster is a flat end-of-turn payout that cares about nothing on the board; tying its targets to position (the units in front of it) would make it a casting piece like the rest.

standouts.why: Hurting your own Encore units at Start of Combat turns a drawback into a trigger, and it lines up with Claque, Natrix and Notices.
Selling as a death links the shop, the Prompter's slot and Birds' Fly South in one card.
Copying the dead lead's Death Scene and leaving a Tail that feeds him back is the most interwoven card in the tribe.

weakest.why: Always-on gold with a bar the tribe clears without trying.
Generic Notices payout with no placement or timing choice.
Does its one job; only interesting next to Bit-Part Lizard and Claque.

flags.note: Rehearser on Dame Natrix in front of the Prompter's Boy is +2/+2 to the board per 3-gold Rehearser, repeatable across the Tier 2 pool.
Old Crest with a golden Prompter, Encore leads and Hesketh still stacks many Death Scenes a fight; a high roll worth a sim.
